name: free_feeding
label: Free Feeding
description: Load all nodes; re-dispense after each PelletTaken (fixed delay or once the animal leaves the pad); end on duration/pellet cap.

parameters.label: Advance to next trial
parameters.help: fixed_delay = wait a fixed time after PelletTaken; presence_clear = wait until the animal is off that node's pad

parameters.label: Presence-clear settle (s)
parameters.help: Used when Advance = presence_clear — presence must stay clear this long before the reload
